# Prompt Catalog

Ultrafuzz ships 57 project-editable workflow prompts and 10 package-owned composition templates. The descriptions are maintained in [`prompt-catalog-data.yml`](prompt-catalog-data.yml); file membership and workflow grouping are derived from the checked-in prompt tree and shipped topologies.

The **Category** column is documentation only. It is not prompt frontmatter or topology configuration.

## Default Campaign Prompts

The default topology binds 43 agentic nodes to 42 distinct prompt files. [`strategies/goal-hunter.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/goal-hunter.mdx) is reused by 2 nodes.

| Filename | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`setup/project-discovery.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/project-discovery.md) | Setup | Inventories the repository's framework, contracts, tests, tooling, coverage, and source-backed invariants before fuzzing begins. |
| [`setup/actors-flows.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/actors-flows.md) | Setup | Maps actors, trust levels, privileges, external dependencies, and major protocol user flows. |
| [`setup/threat-model.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/threat-model.md) | Threat modeling | Builds canonical Markdown and JSON threat models from repository evidence, actors, flows, and controlled capabilities. |
| [`setup/goal-plan.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/goal-plan.md) | Goal planning | Converts modeled threats and applicable vulnerability classes into the dynamic hunting plan. |
| [`strategies/roaming-goal.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/roaming-goal.md) | Goal hunting | Searches for vulnerabilities omitted by both the current threat model and curated vulnerability taxonomy. |
| [`strategies/goal-hunter.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/goal-hunter.mdx) | Goal hunting | Performs a focused hunt for one dynamically assigned threat or vulnerability class. |
| [`setup/prepare-foundry-harness.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/prepare-foundry-harness.md) | Harness setup | Makes the project minimally Foundry-compatible and emits the setup changes used by downstream strategy workspaces. |
| [`setup/discover-base-test.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/setup/discover-base-test.md) | Base fixture | Finds or creates reusable deployment, actor, asset, and allowance fixtures for fuzz and invariant tests. |
| [`properties/certora-thinking-lens.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/certora-thinking-lens.md) | Property design | Derives target properties using the Certora thinking and sanity references. |
| [`properties/property-specification-crytic.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/property-specification-crytic.md) | Property design | Derives target invariants and liveness properties using the Crytic reference. |
| [`properties/property-specification-runtime-verification.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/property-specification-runtime-verification.md) | Property design | Derives target invariants using the Runtime Verification reference. |
| [`properties/property-specification-a16z.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/property-specification-a16z.md) | Property design | Derives target properties using the a16z ERC-4626 reference. |
| [`properties/recon-lens.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/recon-lens.md) | Property design | Derives target properties and invariant-testing candidates using the Recon reference. |
| [`properties/aviggiano-lens.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/aviggiano-lens.md) | Property design | Derives target properties using Antonio Viggiano's property reference. |
| [`properties/0kn0t-lens.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/0kn0t-lens.md) | Property design | Derives target properties using the 0kn0t reference. |
| [`properties/josselin-feist-lens.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/josselin-feist-lens.md) | Property design | Derives DeFi rounding properties using the Montyly rounding reference under the Josselin Feist lens identity. |
| [`properties/property-specification-fanin.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/properties/property-specification-fanin.md) | Property consolidation | Validates, merges, and deduplicates every property lens into one canonical property catalog. |
| [`strategies/boundary-tests.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/boundary-tests.md) | Strategy | Turns properties and workflows into adversarial boundary recipes while investigating confirmed production bugs. |
| [`strategies/encode-decode.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/encode-decode.md) | Strategy | Investigates encoding, decoding, parsing, serialization, and promised inverse relationships. |
| [`strategies/differential-library-tests.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential-library-tests.md) | Strategy | Performs lightweight public-surface differential checks using independently justified comparators. |
| [`strategies/round-trip.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/round-trip.md) | Strategy | Tests paired operations such as deposit and withdraw for source-backed economic and accounting violations. |
| [`strategies/workflow-property-based-tests.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/workflow-property-based-tests.md) | Strategy | Investigates expected behavior, boundaries, access rules, and state transitions across complete user workflows. |
| [`strategies/time-warp-sequences.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/time-warp-sequences.md) | Strategy | Investigates time-dependent bugs across stateful sequences, deadlines, accrual, cooldowns, and stale windows. |
| [`strategies/expand-coverage.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/expand-coverage.md) | Strategy | Targets weakly tested code and workflows where existing analysis provides limited security coverage. |
| [`strategies/admin-config-boundaries.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/admin-config-boundaries.md) | Strategy | Checks admin and configuration authorization, selectors, public documentation, boundary values, and getter reflection. |
| [`strategies/external-dependency-boundaries.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/external-dependency-boundaries.md) | Strategy | Investigates external dependencies and callbacks only where repository evidence makes their behavior in scope. |
| [`strategies/externalized-state-accounting.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/externalized-state-accounting.md) | Strategy | Tests accounting that depends on pending, claimable, escrowed, or externally represented state beyond raw balances. |
| [`strategies/amm-boundary-liquidity.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/amm-boundary-liquidity.md) | Strategy | Exercises AMM liquidity edges, final-liquidity mutations, price bounds, and public reads after boundary states. |
| [`strategies/payable-fallback-accounting.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/payable-fallback-accounting.md) | Strategy | Tests payable and fallback flows, native-token sentinels, stale ETH, funding, and refund ownership. |
| [`strategies/packed-action-parity.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/packed-action-parity.md) | Strategy | Compares packed, compact, or fallback-dispatched actions with their typed public API equivalents. |
| [`strategies/batch-atomicity-unsupported-actions.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/batch-atomicity-unsupported-actions.md) | Strategy | Tests batch and multicall atomicity, unsupported actions, field-width boundaries, and complete rollback. |
| [`strategies/router-exact-accounting.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/router-exact-accounting.md) | Strategy | Compares router quotes with execution funding, returned values, and exact balance deltas. |
| [`strategies/rounding-direction-audit.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/rounding-direction-audit.md) | Strategy | Finds incorrect floor or ceiling choices and cumulative rounding drift in shares, fees, debt, rewards, and rates. |
| [`strategies/market-exhaustion-boundaries.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/market-exhaustion-boundaries.md) | Strategy | Tests final-liquidity consumption, price-level traversal, bitmap edges, and terminal market states. |
| [`strategies/order-replacement-collateral.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/order-replacement-collateral.md) | Strategy | Investigates order replacement, cancellation, partial fills, collateral release, and owner attribution. |
| [`strategies/state-machine-boundaries.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/state-machine-boundaries.md) | Strategy | Tests lifecycle transitions such as pause, lock, close, graduation, finalization, and exact-input fundability. |
| [`strategies/lifecycle-view-boundaries.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/lifecycle-view-boundaries.md) | Strategy | Checks whether documented views remain total, static, and consistent in empty, closed, exhausted, or terminal states. |
| [`review/dedupe-findings.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/review/dedupe-findings.md) | Review | Collapses duplicate and same-root findings while preserving provenance, family variants, tests, and lifecycle records. |
| [`review/triage.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/review/triage.md) | Review | Uses independent review passes to classify findings and audit reachability, dependency scope, rollback, and harness validity. |
| [`review/severity-classification.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/review/severity-classification.md) | Review | Applies reportability gates and assigns canonical impact, likelihood, severity, and final disposition. |
| [`review/aggregate-test-files.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/review/aggregate-test-files.md) | Review | Authenticates generated-test bundles and copies valid atomic bundles into the project's native test tree. |
| [`review/final-report.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/review/final-report.md) | Reporting | Produces the final Markdown and JSON audit reports with issues, non-production outcomes, provenance, and run metadata. |

## Additional Shipped-Profile Prompts

These 15 project-editable prompts are not bound by the default topology, but are used by other shipped topologies. Additional-file counts by topology are `exhaustive` (12), `invariant-only` (5), `smoke` (3); a prompt can appear in more than one topology.

| Filename | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`smoke/json-validation-correction.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/smoke/json-validation-correction.md) | Smoke validation | Proves the producer can observe a schema error, correct its JSON, and successfully revalidate it. |
| [`smoke/smoke-context.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/smoke/smoke-context.md) | Smoke setup | Builds a compact framework, actor, surface, and property map for bounded CI security lanes. |
| [`smoke/smoke-strategy.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/smoke/smoke-strategy.md) | Smoke strategy | Runs one bounded, dynamically selected bug-finding strategy against the shared smoke context. |
| [`strategies/differential/differential-lane-author.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/differential-lane-author.md) | Differential execution | Implements one audited lane, runs its focused comparison, and freezes the first strict semantic mismatch. |
| [`strategies/differential/differential-oracle-planner.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/differential-oracle-planner.md) | Differential planning | Plans deep differential lanes whose expected behavior is justified independently by public evidence. |
| [`strategies/differential/differential-red-triage.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/differential-red-triage.md) | Differential triage | Independently classifies semantic mismatches as harness, reference, production, specification, or unknown failures. |
| [`strategies/differential/differential-repair-and-report-review.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/differential-repair-and-report-review.md) | Differential review | Repairs only consensus harness or reference defects and converts credible production reds into standard findings. |
| [`strategies/differential/reference-and-lane-auditor.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/reference-and-lane-auditor.md) | Differential audit | Audits reference independence and narrows or rejects differential lanes before execution. |
| [`strategies/differential/reference-harness-author.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/differential/reference-harness-author.md) | Differential harness | Authors deliberately simple test-owned reference models and harnesses without copying production internals. |
| [`strategies/dynamic-strategy-generator.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/dynamic-strategy-generator.md) | Dynamic strategy | Uses current-run evidence and enumerator agents to select and execute remaining target-specific investigations. |
| [`strategies/invariants/coverage.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/invariants/coverage.md) | Invariant coverage | Iterates on realistic handler reachability until authenticated Recon-selected coverage reaches its target or a blocker is proven. |
| [`strategies/invariants/handlers.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/invariants/handlers.md) | Invariant handlers | Implements natural stateful action handlers while preserving reachable protocol failures and anti-vacuity. |
| [`strategies/invariants/implement-properties.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/invariants/implement-properties.md) | Invariant properties | Implements selected canonical properties as concrete assertions in the Recon and Chimera suite. |
| [`strategies/invariants/invariant-testing-campaign.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/invariants/invariant-testing-campaign.md) | Invariant campaign | Runs the final supervised Recon fuzzing campaign and records coverage, property results, failures, and reproducible findings. |
| [`strategies/invariants/setup.md`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/strategies/invariants/setup.md) | Invariant setup | Scaffolds a Recon and Chimera stateful invariant suite with realistic deployment, actors, assets, and entrypoint coverage. |

## Runtime Composition Templates

These 10 underscore-prefixed files are package-owned renderer fragments. They are packaged with Ultrafuzz, but `ultrafuzz init` does not scaffold them into target projects and topology nodes cannot bind them directly as workflow prompts.

| Filename | Category | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`_templates/agent-preamble/agent-prompt.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/agent-preamble/agent-prompt.mdx) | Shared preamble | Assembles the security context, trust boundary, runtime context, operator prompt, and workflow prompt into one agent prompt. |
| [`_templates/agent-preamble/authorized-defensive-security-context.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/agent-preamble/authorized-defensive-security-context.mdx) | Shared preamble | Establishes that every task is an authorized local defensive security review. |
| [`_templates/agent-preamble/retry-failure.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/agent-preamble/retry-failure.mdx) | Shared preamble | Presents a previous failure as untrusted diagnostic data before restating the current instructions. |
| [`_templates/agent-preamble/topology-runtime-context.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/agent-preamble/topology-runtime-context.mdx) | Runtime control | Injects timeout, working-budget, deadline, and finalization-reserve instructions into every node. |
| [`_templates/agent-preamble/untrusted-content-boundary.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/agent-preamble/untrusted-content-boundary.mdx) | Trust boundary | Instructs agents to treat repository content and generated artifacts as data rather than executable instructions. |
| [`_templates/output-contract/boundary-recipes.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/output-contract/boundary-recipes.mdx) | Output contract | Defines schema and Markdown-alignment requirements for boundary-recipe outputs. |
| [`_templates/output-contract/coverage-evidence-markdown.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/output-contract/coverage-evidence-markdown.mdx) | Output contract | Defines the canonical sanitized Markdown rendering for measured or unavailable coverage evidence. |
| [`_templates/output-contract/findings.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/output-contract/findings.mdx) | Output contract | Defines findings-schema validation, evidence semantics, and preliminary-severity ownership. |
| [`_templates/output-contract/generated-tests.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/output-contract/generated-tests.mdx) | Output contract | Defines the atomic generated-test manifest, companion-file, framework, and validation rules. |
| [`_templates/output-contract/output-contract.mdx`](../../.ultrafuzz/prompts/_templates/output-contract/output-contract.mdx) | Output contract | Defines the universal artifact-writing and validation process appended to workflow prompts. |
